Container.Name: Augur
Container.Overview: Discord request bot for Seerr with account linking, media previews, request limits, and completion DMs.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent config and SQLite database files.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: UID used to run Augur and own persistent files.

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: GID used to run Augur and own persistent files.

Config.Name: Discord Token
Config.Description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal.

Config.Name: Guild ID
Config.Description: Optional Discord server ID. Set this while testing for faster slash command updates.

Config.Name: Seerr Internal URL
Config.Description: Internal Seerr URL reachable from this container, for example http://seerr:5055.

Config.Name: Seerr Public URL
Config.Description: Browser-facing Seerr URL. /link sends users to /profile/settings/notifications/discord under this URL.

Config.Name: Require Linked User
Config.Description: Require the user's Discord ID64 to be present in their Seerr notification settings before allowing /request.

Config.Name: Database Path
Config.Description: SQLite database file path inside the container.

Config.Name: Poll Interval
Config.Description: How often Augur checks Seerr for completed requests.

Config.Name: Health Port
Config.Description: Optional HTTP health, readiness, and JSON metrics port.

Config.Name: Health Address
Config.Description: Listen address for the health server inside the container.
